environment.description: EKS pod running with IAM role arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/StreamProcessorRole attached via IRSA. The role has ec2:DescribeInstances, s3:GetObject on sensitive buckets, and sts:AssumeRole permissions. Instance metadata service (IMDS) v1 enabled on the node (hop limit=1 but pod uses host networking). No network policies restricting egress to 169.254.169.254. DNS resolution is unrestricted.
